timing_definitions.gpu: Root viewport GPU render time; all-zero output means unavailable, never a measured zero cost
timing_definitions.cpu: CPU process, physics, viewport render and render setup are separate monitors, not a non-overlapping total

methodology.repetitions: Two independent measurements per biome/preset. Table reports each run rather than averaging percentiles or hiding variation.
methodology.resolution: 1920x1080 fullscreen, VSync disabled, unlimited fps. Low uses Compatibility; Medium/High use Forward+ as the F26 harness specifies.
methodology.duration: Preparation encountered insufficient disk space twice (download/export); retained failure metadata and rescaled export resource scope. Fresh process/world/shader initialization precedes each timed interval and lengthens total wall time.
methodology.image_capture: Existing start/end route screenshots occur outside the timed interval; no screenshots are written during the measured traversal.
methodology.routes: Existing seed-2042 F26 routes, real physics traversal, fresh isolated user home per run. Fifteen seconds elapsed warmup; at least sixty seconds timed. Short routes hold their final pose for the remaining interval; Cloudreach and Stormwood time the longer full route.
methodology.shipping_source: Published latest release source 7c7d25873cec69c1720b1964af9fd4b94151bee5; shipping executable verified, instrumented PCK exported in release mode. This is the permitted release-mode capture-tool fallback, not a byte-identical shipping PCK.
methodology.cpu_interpretation: CPU render+setup measures renderer CPU work only. Process and physics monitors are reported separately; they overlap and must not be added into a purported total CPU frame time. GPU root viewport timing excludes unrelated desktop GPU work.

quality_status: complete_with_release_defect: all six Stormwood runs reported missing/stale scatter; these rows do not certify the complete biome

release_comparison.note: Re-export is not byte-identical to shipping. Full resource differences retained. Stormwood timings are qualified because scatter failed to load.
